## 更新内容

- 设置页「技能管理」中的 `word-optimization` 现在默认启用，新安装或缺少该字段的配置会自动启用 Word 导出版式优化。
- 已手动停用 `word-optimization` 的用户配置会继续保持停用，不会被版本更新强制覆盖。
- 设置页中该技能的关闭状态文案由「默认关闭」调整为「已停用」，与新的默认状态保持一致。

## What's Changed

- `word-optimization` in Settings > Skill Management is now enabled by default. New installs and configs missing this field will automatically enable Word export layout optimization.
- Existing user configs that explicitly disabled `word-optimization` remain disabled and are not forced back on during upgrade.
- The disabled-state label for this skill now reads as disabled instead of default-off, matching the new default behavior.
